# RIPR-SPEC-NNNN: Title

Status: proposed

Owner: Name or team

Created: YYYY-MM-DD

Linked proposal: None or RIPR-PROP-NNNN

Linked ADRs: None or ADR-NNNN

Linked plan: None or path

Linked issues: None or #NNNN

Linked PRs: None or #NNNN

Support-tier impact: None or describe the affected claim

Policy impact: None or describe the affected policy

## Problem

Describe the user or integration problem this behavior solves.

## Behavior

Describe the observable behavior that must be true.

## Required Evidence

List the data, output, diagnostics, or receipts required to establish the behavior.

## Inputs

Describe the relevant inputs and their bounded forms.

## Outputs

Describe the relevant outputs and their stable contract.

## Acceptance Examples

Show the smallest examples that prove the behavior.

## Test Mapping

Name current or planned tests and fixtures.

## Implementation Mapping

Name the production modules or planned implementation seams.

## CI Proof

Name the commands and CI lanes that prove the change.

## Metrics

Describe measurements and any explicit promotion evidence. Metrics do not
change document disposition or establish implementation, evidence, or support
on their own.

## Failure Modes

Describe bounded failures, limitations, and fail-closed behavior.
